text.p: Italian bonds and futures closed quietly lower ahead of preliminary September inflation data from six Italian cities, with the market cautious over possible snags over the 1997 budget package, traders said.
The market was also impacted by the fall in German bunds on profit-taking and a lower start to U.S. Treasuries ahead of the Fed Open Market Committee meeting on Tuesday.
"We rose a lot and very rapidly in recent sessions,now we need a new boost to retest highs," one trader said. The December Btp contract was well off its day high of 119.05, but off lows at 118.45.
